name: grab-and-go
description: Grab & Go — Order ahead. Skip the line. Pickup-first ordering platform for cafes, launching in Karachi.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @grabgo/types && npm run build -w @grabgo/config && npm run build -w @grabgo/core && npm run build -w @grabgo/validation && npm run build -w @grabgo/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @grabgo/api && npm run build -w @grabgo/merchant-dashboard && npm run build -w @grabgo/admin-dashboard
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate
scripts.test: npm run test -w @grabgo/core && npm run test -w @grabgo/validation && npm run test -w @grabgo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @grabgo/api && npm run typecheck -w @grabgo/merchant-dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @grabgo/admin-dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @grabgo/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
